children.name: Penthorum chinense Pursh
children.description: Penthorum chinense, commonly known as Oriental penthorum, is a plant species native to much of East Asia.

children.name: Penthorum sedoides L.
children.description: Penthorum sedoides, known by the common name ditch stonecrop, is a perennial forb native to the eastern United States and Canada which produces small white flowers in summer.
